Welcome to PSCC

Pharma-Medical Science College of Canada is a leading pharmaceutical and medical training college in North America, hundreds of our graduates have found a career in different pharma-medical related companies all over the world. Our high-quality education and successful employment rate in our college have built up an excellent reputation within the society and the industry.

We are dedicating to provide variety diploma and certificate programs in the pharmaceutical, cosmetics, medical, food and human service. Six modern laboratories in our college enrich the students’ knowledge with practical skills and hands-on experience endowed with a very competitive workforce, including Quality Control/ Quality Assurance Lab, Medical Lab Technician Practice Lab, Pharmaceutical Manufacturing Lab, Personal Support Worker Practice Lab, Pharmacy Assistant Practice Lab, and Ultrasound Technician Practice Lab.
